pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-tone pixel pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Pathway thickness remains relatively constant across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck mane. The silhouette exhibits a fuzzy texture with short vertical pixel groupings.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive ventral protrusion visible on the midline, appearing as a localized anatomical extension with high-contrast shadowing.
